verdict.rationale: Replit's docs describe a dedicated flow to start from a Replit Design template, have Agent turn the selected frame into a functional website, test it in Preview, and publish a live URL (replit-docs-15, replit-docs-22). That covers the core of starting from a template rather than a blank prompt. Missing for 10: evidence of starting from or remixing community projects, any description of the breadth of the template catalog beyond design templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the template flow.
